units.source_text: 在公寓里他提出一个离奇的建议。

en.t: At the apartment, he made a bizarre proposal.

units.source_text: 尺八其是物归原主，辞典算是礼物，两样东西都暂且归他所有，所以卖这些东西所得的5册元也算是柏木的钱了。

en.t: The shakuhachi had simply been returned to its owner, and the dictionary counted as a gift; since both items belonged to him for the time being, the 500 yen obtained by selling them also counted as Kashiwagi's money.

units.source_text: 这500元，再加上2500元，借款当然总共是3000元。

en.t: Adding 2,500 yen to that 500 yen, the loan naturally came to a total of 3,000 yen.

units.source_text: 归还时止，月息按一分计算。

en.t: Until it was repaid, the monthly interest would be calculated at one percent.

units.source_text: 比起"光俱乐部"的高利贷月息三分四厘来，几乎是优惠得多了……

en.t: Compared with the Hikari Club loan sharks' monthly interest of three point four percent, it was almost a much more favorable rate...

units.source_text: 柏木拿出了纸和视台，正经八百地把这些条件都写在纸上，然后让我在借条上签字画押。

en.t: Kashiwagi took out paper and an ink pad, solemnly wrote all these terms down on the paper, and then made me sign and seal the promissory note.

units.source_text: 我不愿意考虑将来了，所以马上用拇指沾上印泥捺下了一个指印。

en.t: I did not want to think about the future, so I immediately pressed my thumb into the red seal paste and left a thumbprint.
